test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following has become the first life insurance company to provide its customers with the UPI AutoPay facility?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ICICI Prudential Life.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **ICICI Prudential Life Insurance,** a private sector life insurer, collaborated with the** National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) **to provide its clients with the** Unified Payments Interface (UPI) AutoPay** feature.
 
• Customers of ICICI Prudential can easily** purchase insurance plans** and** pay premiums** using this option.
 
• Customers of ICICI Prudential can enable the UPI AutoPay feature on their **preferred UPI apps,** including **Paytm, BHIM, and others.**
 
• Through an **e-mandate,** this feature can also be enabled for** ICICI Bank and other well-known banks.**
 
• Customers have the option to choose between** making premium payments** on a** monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or annual basis.****​**
 
• ICICI Prudential Life Insurance:
